changelog:
- Initial release of the conference-talk-proposal skill.
- Generates compelling conference talk proposals with title options, an engaging abstract, concrete audience takeaways, a clear outline, and a targeted speaker pitch.
- Guides users to provide necessary input (topic, audience, story, format) and covers best practices for CFP submissions.
- Output includes public sections (for CFP) and private notes for organizers, plus a concise speaker bio.
- Built-in quality checks and anti-patterns help ensure submissions stand out and match conference expectations.
